description: WACC / discount-rate benchmarks for rNPV. Single-asset biotech rNPV typically uses the equity cost of capital because phase-gated probability already prices most idiosyncratic risk; using a high systemic-risk-adjusted WACC double-counts.

primary_sources.citation: Damodaran A. Cost of Capital by Industry (US), updated Jan 2025. NYU Stern.
primary_sources.note: Biotech industry cost of equity ~10-11%, beta ~1.2.

primary_sources.citation: Stewart JJ, Allison PN, Johnson RS. Putting a price on biotechnology. Nature Biotechnology 19, 813-817 (2001).
primary_sources.note: Foundational treatment of rNPV discount rates by stage.

benchmarks.rationale: Highest cost of capital for un-validated private biotech.
Public micro-cap with one or two clinical assets.
Reference tier for the adagrasib backtest (Mirati at Phase 2 KRYSTAL-1).
Commercial biotech / large pharma — closer to industry beta.
